target.title: fix(ui): prevent configuration edits from disappearing during operations
target.body:
Closes #105532

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users editing configuration in the Control UI could keep changing structured, raw, or Quick Settings controls while a save, apply, reload, or update operation was pending. The subsequent authoritative refresh then replaced those accepted edits without warning.

## Why This Change Was Made

Configuration operations now publish their pending state before the first asynchronous wait, and every config-backed editor uses one operation-wide busy state. Update-triggered locking follows the existing restart reconciliation lifecycle through managed-service handoff and reconnect instead of ending when the initial RPC returns.

## User Impact

Configuration controls now lock for the full duration of an operation and become editable again only after the authoritative result settles. Users can no longer type changes into a draft window that is about to be replaced by a save, reload, apply, or Gateway update refresh.

## Evidence

- Before fix, a real-Gateway Playwright run observed the raw editor enabled during delayed `config.set`; late input was accepted and then absent after settlement.
- After fix, the rebuilt Control UI reported the editor disabled during the same delayed request, rejected the late fill, retained no late marker, and restored the original configuration.
- An isolated source-blind Playwright contract repeated the race with two distinct MCP Runtime Idle TTL values. Both runs locked the field and Save action, rejected late input, persisted only the submitted value after reload, re-enabled controls after settlement, and restored the original value.
- Blacksmith Testbox `jade-hermit-0d8c`: `corepack pnpm test ui/src/app/overlays.test.ts ui/src/lib/config/index.test.ts ui/src/pages/config/view.browser.test.ts ui/src/pages/config/quick.test.ts ui/src/pages/config/config-page.test.ts` — 5 files, 108 tests passed.
- Blacksmith Testbox `jade-hermit-0d8c`: `corepack pnpm check:changed` — passed in 9m57s, including formatting, core/UI typechecks, repository guards, and selected lint shards.
- `OPENCLAW_BUILD_ALL_NO_PNPM=1 node scripts/ui.js build` — passed.
- Fresh structured autoreview — no accepted or actionable findings.
